tools.name: get_arbitrage_opportunities
tools.description: Read-only operation — no side effects, no parameters. Returns live cross-DEX arbitrage spreads on Base, refreshed every 60 seconds. Use it for executable price gaps between venues; use get_market_stats for aggregate prices or get_trading_signal for directional calls.

tools.name: verify_seller_receiver
tools.description: Read-only; REQUIRES `receiver`. Audits ANY receiver's incoming USDC on Base: distinct payers, repeat payers, concentration, probes vs customers. Decides whether a seller is safe to pay. Reports partial/failed, never a zero it did not measure.
